  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hd (g₃ y)
  have h5 : f₄ x = 0 := he (by
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun h4 x
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
    rw [map_zero, ← this, hx]
    exact (eg3 (g₃ y)).2 ⟨y, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := (ef3 x).1 h5
  have h6 : g₃ (y - c u) = 0 := by
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun h3 u
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
    rw [map_sub, this, hx, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (eg2 _).1 h6
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hb v
  refine ⟨u + f₂ w, ?_⟩
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun h2 w
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
  rw [map_add, ← this, hv]
  abel
